prompt: How should a boat on today’s distance board be set up before it starts?
promptZh: 如果今天想登上距離榜，紙船出發前應怎麼準備？

options.text: Fit the small sail low and leave it there for the whole course
options.zh: 把小帆裝低，全程維持原樣
options.whyZh: 進入開放區後可用，但小帆裝低時，在擋風板後幾乎不動。

options.text: Fit the large sail high and leave it there through the bend
options.zh: 把大帆架高，過彎後仍保留原樣
options.whyZh: 大帆在擋風板後能走，但到了開放區會折下來；錄音沒有說架高可解決。

options.text: Fit the large sail at first and replace it after the bend
options.zh: 起航用大帆，過彎後再換
options.whyZh: 做法能因應不同區段，但要上榜，下水後不能換帆。

options.text: Fit the small sail on the taller mast at the start and leave it there
options.zh: 起航前把小帆裝在高桅桿上，全程保留
options.whyZh: 小帆架高在擋風板後才動得起來，在開放區用任一高度都可以，也不必半途換帆。

evidence:
Boats on that board cannot change sails after launch.
Today we’ll start behind the wind screen, then turn out into the open.
The small one worked in the open at either height.
Behind the screen it barely moved until we raised it on the taller mast.
explanationZh: 小帆架高在擋風板後才動得起來，在開放區用任一高度都可以，也不必半途換帆。

vocabulary.note: 船上用來撐住帆的直立杆件。
